transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Let's get into the disposition huddle for the 1,200 actuator housings on hold. We've got production capacity available this week if we decide on rework, so I want to hear from Quality and Customer Fulfillment before I make the call. Quality, what are your findings on the revised drawing and how it affects these housings? And Customer Fulfillment, what's the status on the customer side -- are there delivery commitments we need to factor in?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I completed the dimensional review this morning using the validated gauge. Here's what I found: exactly 700 of the 1,200 housings can be reworked to the revised drawing, but exactly 500 cannot be reworked and must be scrapped. Each reworked housing requires exactly 10 hours of machining and 100% dimensional inspection before release. The review is still in the engineering hold folder pending this disposition huddle.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I've received written acceptance from North Plant that exactly 500 housings made to the old drawing may ship by Wednesday at 16:00, and South Plant's order requires exactly 700 housings made to the revised drawing by Friday at 12:00. I haven't entered the acceptance in the order system yet because the held-material disposition is still awaiting Marisol's approval.
